canonical_public_shell.activation_policy: Canonical company and product routes. Existing retained routes remain visually unchanged until their approved activation packet; missing routes adopt this shell when created.

protected_internal_shell.activation_policy: Protected auth, admin, application, purchaser, transaction, diagnostic, and internal-tool routes retain isolated compatibility behavior until their obligations close.

temporary_legacy_compatibility.activation_policy: Legacy public pages retain current shell compatibility only until canonical replacement, redirect, archive, or retirement validation succeeds.

no_shared_shell.activation_policy: Documentation, error, maintenance, unsubscribe, redirect, API, webhook, health, OG, and compatibility-handler routes do not inherit the shared public chrome.

providers.protected_behavior: Protected and internal routes receive only route-specific metadata required for operation.
Protected routes are excluded unless an explicit operational analytics requirement is approved.

providers.destination: temporary legacy and protected compatibility shell
providers.protected_behavior: Canonical public shell is light-first and has no root theme provider; next-themes expires after legacy and protected consumers migrate.

providers.destination: protected internal or transactional provider boundary
providers.protected_behavior: Canonical public forms use local accessible status regions; global React Hot Toast remains only for exact legacy consumers until migration.

providers.destination: local component ownership using the canonical tooltip primitive
providers.protected_behavior: Global React Tooltip remains temporary compatibility only; new public shell does not mount a global tooltip registry.

providers.destination: protected internal shell or route-local boundary
providers.protected_behavior: No auth provider or sign-in affordance is required by the canonical public shell.

providers.current_owner: protected commerce, licence, purchaser, processing, and success routes
providers.destination: protected transactional shell or route-local boundary
providers.protected_behavior: No Stripe, licence, purchaser, or portal provider is mounted by the canonical public shell.

compatibility_aliases.expiry_condition: All legacy and protected consumers use --font-prochat-sans and --font-prochat-mono or have been archived; Tailwind no longer maps font utilities to legacy variables.
Canonical Header, layout, button, section, and protected compatibility consumers no longer reference the legacy dimensions.
Tailwind semantic utilities and all protected or route-local CSS consume canonical foundation tokens or have been archived.
Legacy marketing, background, icon, and Tailwind color consumers are replaced or archived and no public metadata or inline style uses the old blue scale.
Canonical neutral shadows replace legacy Tailwind, Contact, and toaster consumers, or protected consumers are isolated and documented.

packet_3.name: shell-routing-boundary
packet_3.rule: Packet 3 creates live route-aware shell and provider boundaries while preserving current output for every existing route. No current page adopts the canonical visual shell until its page or design wave is approved.
packet_3.approval_gate: Approve only after route output equivalence, provider ownership, protected-flow smoke tests, accessibility checks, and rollback verification pass.
